phoneNoteBefore: Idan kuna magana da Turanci ko Faransanci, zaku iya kiran ni a
quote: “Umar wani taro ne na mutane da wani rundunar ta gudanar. Wadannan tarurrukan galibi sun bi ma'anar Horace game da manufofin waƙa, “ko dai don faranta ko don ilmantarwa” (Latin: aut delectare aut prodesse). Har yanzu ana gudanar da salula a cikin al'adar adabin Faransanci da ƙungiyoyin falsafa na karni na 17 da 18. Salon ya fara bayyana a Italiya a cikin karni na 16, sannan ya bunkasa a Faransa a cikin ƙarni na 17 da 18. [...] Salunan sun kasance muhimmin wuri don musayar ra'ayoyi. Kalmar salon ta fara bayyana a Faransa a shekarar 1664 (daga salone na Italiyanci, babban zauren liyafa na gidajen Italiyanci; salone a zahiri shine nau'in haɓaka sala, ɗaki).”
